policies.name: Single-Use Plastic Phase-Out Roadmap
policies.summary: Bans plastic straws in chain restaurants since 2019; targets a complete phase-out of single-use bags, cups, utensils, and straws by 2030.

newsFeed.headline: Taiwan beach cleanups recover record 380 tonnes of plastic in 2024
newsFeed.summary: Coordinated coastal cleanups across 19 counties pulled in a record haul, more than half of it single-use plastic packaging.

wooby.headline: Taiwan is small but ambitious about ditching single-use plastic.
wooby.narrative: Wooby loves the warm waters around Taiwan. Taiwan has banned plastic straws in big restaurants and wants to end single-use plastic by 2030. Wooby thinks Taiwan is a great example for other small islands.
